title: Closeout reconciliation: Ready-to-Close, historical checks, and terminal cleanup replay

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Substantive implementation commit. Post-merge closeout automation rebinds this field to the authoritative merge SHA.

verifier.independence_note: Executor-produced mechanical evidence; this is not PM approval or independent certification.

pnpm_verify.detail: Environment, alignment, automation coverage, lint, type-check, build, aggregate tests, command verification, live database smoke, and the T1 live-proof suite passed.

focused_tests.detail: Covers exact and app-bound required-check identity, latest-result symmetry, check-run and status pagination, the PR #1305 expected historical failure, canonical L3 states, workflow event gating, trusted PR validation, and idempotent terminal cleanup without terminal-truth rewrites.

runtime_proof.classification: Governance and workflow tooling change. Runtime proof combines the mandatory live Supabase T1 gate with a read-only live GitHub evaluation of the historical required-check incident.

historical_required_check.selection_reason: latest result with exact required context and app identity

non_satisfying_run.name: Executor Result Validator
non_satisfying_run.reason: Different check name; it cannot satisfy Executor Result Validation.

queries.description: Fetched every check-run page for the historical PR #1305 head and selected the latest exact app-bound required context.
Fetched every commit-status page for the same head so legacy status contexts participate without overriding app-bound checks.
Exercised live repository submission, lifecycle, outbox, audit, settlement, correction, and participant invariants through the existing T1 smoke suite.

row_counts.note: The live suite asserts rollback row counts and cleans up its own unique fixtures.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: L3 accepts exactly Ready to Close, In PM Review, and Done.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The permitted-state set contains those three values; focused tests accept each and reject execution, proof, blocked, backlog, cancelled, stale, empty, and unknown states.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Historical G4 truth uses exact branch-protection identity, full pagination, and the latest canonical result.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Required-check identities retain app_id; check-run and commit-status endpoints paginate to exhaustion; selection sorts exact candidates by timestamp with deterministic tie breaks.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: PR #1305 remains a genuine expected failure rather than receiving a special-case pass.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Both the captured fixture and read-only live GitHub evaluation select failed run 89533838816 for Executor Result Validation/app 15368; the differently named earlier success is excluded.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Newer failure beats older success and newer success beats older failure.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Focused symmetric tests cover both orderings independently of API result order.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: The existing Merge-Gate-only admin exception is preserved without broadening.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Head fallback still permits bypass only when every missing context matches Merge Gate or Merge Gate CI; any non-governance failure remains failing with structured evidence.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Ordinary push handling of done lanes remains a no-op; only explicit trusted workflow dispatch can request terminal cleanup.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The workflow status gate requires workflow_dispatch plus non-empty explicit PR for a done lane; push and dispatch-without-PR both remain non-closeable.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Trusted done-lane cleanup is validated, idempotent, and does not rewrite terminal authority.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The UTV2-1589/PR #1308 fixture validates the supplied PR, removes residual sync state, releases supported coordination state, and performs safe worktree cleanup twice while preserving the manifest byte-for-byte, including PR URL, merge SHA, closed_at, proof bindings, and truth history.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: UTV2-1586 can proceed through the canonical Ready to Close state after this fix.
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: L3 now recognizes Ready to Close, and the existing UTV2-1586 trusted repair success fixture continues to reach done with terminal cleanup.

known_limitations: The hosted post-merge runner can remove only worktrees visible on that machine. An original machine-local worktree path is safely classified as already absent and remains subject to orchestration reconciliation.
UTV2-1585 is intentionally not closed by this lane; its genuine historical required-check failure remains dependent on UTV2-1591's separate certification design.
